founderNoteBody:
Hello, I'm Levi. I began building WitnessWork in 2023 to solve challenges I personally faced while pioneering. What started as a simple idea has grown into a true labor of love, shaped over many late nights and steady refinement.

It's been deeply encouraging to hear from brothers and sisters around the world who are benefiting from it. My hope is that this tool serves you well for many years to come.

With brotherly love,

milestoneSecondary_recurring_description: Schedule by day-of-week and week-of-month, with overrides and deletions.

1382.c11: Beautiful new celebrations the moment you cross a goal.

1382.c13: Schedule screen: a focused calendar view of day plans and recurring conversations.
1382.c14: A redesigned profile card on the home screen showing your role, time served, and fun stats.
1382.c15: Approaching and missed conversations now surface on the home screen so you never lose track.
1382.c16: Phone region code now persists across new contacts. Phone region search is faster and more accurate.
1382.c17: Map empty state, location prompts, and contact map clustering have all been polished.
1382.c18: Countless small bug fixes, performance improvements, and visual refinements throughout the app.

1383.c1: Plans now have a Type. Assign a category to a scheduled plan and your projected totals reflect the right kind of credit.
1383.c2: Projected totals are more accurate. They respect your monthly credit cap and no longer double-count time you've already logged today.
1383.c3: The celebration chime once again respects your ring/silent switch.
1383.c5: New contacts and address edits now save immediately, even before the geocode api finishes locating them.
1383.c6: The calendar refreshes right away after you add, edit, or remove a plan.
1383.c7: Map pins stay in focus after you tap them. Resolve intermittent issue with map refocusing incorrect contact pin.
1383.c8: Smoother scrolling in the Contacts list. Resolve issues with contacts disappearing.
1383.c4: Your Donations now shows the correct billing period and price for annual and granted supporter subscriptions.

1400.c1: Switching from MyTime? You can now import your contacts and visit history straight from a MyTime backup, with a preview before anything is added, so there's no manual re-entry.
1400.c2: Date format, clock style, and start of the week are now separate from your app language. Set each one in Settings > Date & Time, with an Auto option that follows your region or device.
1400.c3: You can now customize the day thresholds and colors behind contact staleness. Tune them in Settings > Personalization > Color Key.
1400.c4: Resolved an issue with the map search auto closing.
1400.c5: Locating contacts on the map now shows live progress, and you can skip it midway without losing your place.
1400.c6: Faster, smoother scrolling in the Contacts list, plus quicker home screen widget updates.
1400.c7: Fixed projected totals around time zone changes, enlarged header buttons for easier tapping, and polished countless small details throughout the app.

1411.c1: New: Meet Scribe AI. Paste your field-ministry notes, whether a handwritten-style log or an export from another app, and Scribe AI turns them into contacts, visits, and time entries for you to review before anything is saved. Refine the results by chatting inline, start an import right from onboarding, and never lose a credit on an import that finds nothing.
1411.c2: A new customizable This Month dashboard on the home screen. Your goal, projection, and schedule pace live in cards you can arrange and expand, while your Service Report stays in one clean card. Tap the report for a full breakdown.
1411.c3: Monthly goal overrides. Set a different goal for a single month when your circumstances change, and see your planned hours as their own progress ring.
1411.c4: Plan more than one thing per day. Day plans on the same date now add together, each keeping its own category, and plans that do not count toward a day are clearly marked.
1411.c5: Easier editing everywhere. Plans, time entries, and conversations now have an ellipsis menu for Edit and Delete, and recurring plans offer clear choices for changing one date, future dates, or the whole series.
1411.c6: Service Reports: Hourglass and NW Publisher submission are back, you can pick a default submission method, edit the report comment before sending, and get a month-end reminder. The year-by-year history can now be trimmed or backfilled with earlier years.
1411.c7: Schedule now shows each day's status at a glance: ahead, behind, on track, upcoming, matched, or no plan.
1411.c8: Supporter status now follows your Apple ID across devices, Scribe AI allowances roll over on a schedule, and the Supporter screen has been simplified.
1411.c9: Fixed time entries and plans landing on the wrong day in time zones at UTC+12 and beyond, plus wrong-day dates late in the evening west of UTC. Fixed map pins opening the wrong contact after swiping the card carousel. Time rollover now keeps Credit Time in its original month by default.
1411.c10: The Credit toggle on categories is now available to every hours-based role. Also fixed a rare crash when closing a picker, restored favorite stars and the current-month Bible study icon, updated to Expo SDK 57, and trimmed the app size.

1420.c1: New iPad layouts show contacts, maps, and schedules alongside their details.
1420.c2: Customize contact fields: reorder phone, email, and custom fields, hide phone or email, and permanently delete archived custom fields.
1420.c3: See your logged time by category across the Service Year, and adjust the monthly credit limit in supported Publisher preferences.
1420.c4: Hourglass submissions now separate preaching time from Credit Time.
1420.c5: The calendar Assistant is available again, with controls in Schedule preferences.

1430.c1: Data protection mode for publishers in the EU, the UK and Switzerland keeps householder records to what the law allows, including consent tracking and cleanup of contacts you haven't visited in a while.
1430.c2: Create a contact right from a pin you drop on the map.
1430.c3: Kingdom Publishers can choose to log their hours with a timer, an optional monthly goal and the Progress tab.
1430.c4: The Year tab now shows your service-year total for every role, even without an annual goal.
1430.c5: Follow-ups on visits are now optional, and you can turn off app sounds in Preferences.
1430.c6: Fixed dates shifting for publishers in far-east time zones.

1440.c1: Simpler navigation with four labeled tabs you can reorder. The map now lives at the top of Contacts, and Settings is under your profile picture.
1440.c2: Contacts are redesigned around what's next, with every visit on a timeline. Log a visit from the + menu with nearby suggestions, and add custom fields to conversations.
1440.c3: Schedule has a zoomable year and month calendar, and a plan can be just hours or a time span.
1440.c4: See your service year's pace month by month, and celebrate streaks and badges along the way.
1440.c5: Optional mileage tracking logs your trips and fuel costs.
1440.c6: Follow-ups can sync to a calendar just for WitnessWork, now on Android too, where you can also back up and sync with Google Drive.
1440.c7: Reminders wait in the notification bell instead of piling up on Home.

1450.c1: Meet Scribe AI: speak or type an update, and it logs your time, plans your days, adds contacts and logs visits. Nothing is saved until you tap Add.
1450.c2: Adopt a pet companion on Home. It stays happy while you keep going out in the ministry, and unlocks room items, hats and secret surprises along the way.
1450.c3: The new Account screen backs up your data to WitnessWork with end-to-end encryption, gives you a recovery key, and sets up another device with a QR code.
1450.c4: Supporters can sync between iPhone and Android with end-to-end encrypted Cloud Sync, and plan a day's route with stops in the best order.
1450.c5: Lock the app behind your face, fingerprint or passcode.
1450.c6: WitnessWork is now available in Arabic, with layouts that read right to left.
1450.c7: Customize the cards on Home and Progress, format notes and add photos, filter contacts by follow-up, and see when each month's report was sent.
1450.c8: Better support for large text sizes, screen readers, bold text and higher contrast.

1460.c1: Your pet now earns gold coins each day you go out in the ministry. Spend them in the new Shop on hats and room items, and find everything you own in its Locker.
1460.c2: Tap your streak on Home to see when it started and your best streak so far.
1460.c3: You can turn off Scribe AI in Settings, and it asks for your agreement before you use it the first time.

iCloudImagesEnableConfirm_description:
Your profile picture, any contact photos you've added, and the photos in your notes will be copied to your iCloud Drive. They'll sync to your other devices and count against your iCloud storage quota — the cropped profile and contact photos are uploaded; uncropped originals stay on the device where you selected them.

For the strongest privacy, we recommend enabling Advanced Data Protection for iCloud (Settings → [Your Name] → iCloud → Advanced Data Protection) so images are end-to-end encrypted with only your devices holding the keys.
iCloudImagesEnableConfirm_descriptionAnd: Your profile picture, any contact photos you've added, and the photos in your notes will be copied to your Google Drive. They'll sync to your other devices and count against your Google storage — the cropped profile and contact photos are uploaded; uncropped originals stay on the device where you selected them.

dataProtectionDesc: Only recommended if you live in the **EU, the UK or Switzerland**.
dataProtectionInfoDesc: Courts in the EU have ruled that notes about people met in the ministry fall under data protection law. With this on, WitnessWork only stores a householder's details after they agree, hides fields for photos and gender, warns about sensitive custom fields, does not record not-at-home visits, keeps address lookups on your device, turns off contact sharing, and offers to delete contacts you have not visited in 90 days. Scribe AI still sends what you say or type to a third-party AI service for processing, but does not send your contact list or visit notes. If you enable iCloud sync, your records are stored in iCloud and synced across your devices. If you turn on Backup in Settings → Account, an end-to-end encrypted copy is kept on WitnessWork's server that only your devices can read. This is not legal advice — follow your branch's direction.
dataProtectionInfoDescAndroid: Courts in the EU have ruled that notes about people met in the ministry fall under data protection law. With this on, WitnessWork only stores a householder's details after they agree, hides fields for photos and gender, warns about sensitive custom fields, does not record not-at-home visits, keeps address lookups on your device, turns off contact sharing, and offers to delete contacts you have not visited in 90 days. Scribe AI still sends what you say or type to a third-party AI service for processing, but does not send your contact list or visit notes. If you enable Google Drive sync, your records are stored in your Google Drive and synced across your devices. If you turn on Backup in Settings → Account, an end-to-end encrypted copy is kept on WitnessWork's server that only your devices can read. This is not legal advice — follow your branch's direction.

accountKeyChange_info: Your account stays the same: its number, Supporter status, Cloud Sync, backups, and account activity. Only the key changes. Backup files saved with “My Account” still open. A change can't be undone, and WitnessWork support can't bring back an old key.
accountKeyChange_pointDevices: Your other devices are signed out. Their records stay, and they sign back in with the new recovery key or a QR code from a signed-in device.
accountKeyChange_pointBuddies: Your buddies get an invite to reconnect.
accountKeyChange_pointData: Your Cloud Sync data and backups are locked with the new key.
accountKeyChange_appleNote: Lost an iPhone, iPad, or Mac? Remove it from your Apple Account first. Devices signed in to your Apple Account get the new key through iCloud Keychain.
accountKeyChange_tooOldBody: They have an older version of WitnessWork that can't sign back in after the change. Update it on them first, or they'll show an error until it's updated.
accountKeyChange_tooOldUnknown: Your other devices couldn't be checked. One with an older version of WitnessWork can't sign back in after the change until it's updated.
accountKeyChange_unlockFailed: This device couldn't confirm it's you, so nothing changed.
accountKeyChange_preparingDetail: Saving your latest changes to Cloud Sync and Backup.
accountKeyChange_newKeyBody: Save it now. After the change, only this key signs in to your account. A change can't be undone, and WitnessWork support can't bring back an old key.
accountKeyChange_saved: I've saved my new recovery key
accountKeyChange_changingDetail: Keep WitnessWork open. If it closes, it picks up where it stopped.
accountKeyChange_stageReseal: Locking Cloud Sync and backups with it
accountKeyChange_doneBody: Your old recovery key no longer works. Sign your other devices back in with the new one, or with a QR code from this device.
accountKeyChange_finishingTitle: Your new key is in use
accountKeyChange_finishingBody: A few things are still finishing. WitnessWork keeps trying each time you open it.
accountKeyChange_lostTitle: The key was changed on another device
accountKeyChange_lostBody: Your account key was just changed somewhere else, so the recovery key shown here won't work. Sign back in with the new recovery key from that device.
accountKeyChange_problemOffline: Connect to the internet to change your account key.
accountKeyChange_problemServer: Your account key couldn't be changed right now. Try again in a few minutes.
accountKeyChange_problemSessionTooNew: This browser signed in less than a day ago, so it can't change your account key yet. Try again tomorrow, or use your phone.
accountKeyChange_problemStepUp: Confirm it's you with your passkey, then try again.
accountKeyChange_problemMismatch: This device isn't signed in to your account right now. Sign in again, then change the key.
accountKeyChange_resumeBody: Continue to finish changing your key, or discard the new one and keep your current recovery key.
accountKeyChange_resumeToast: Your account key change isn't finished
accountKeyChange_resumeToastDetail: Tap to continue or discard the new key.
accountKeyChange_discardBody: Your current recovery key keeps working.
accountKeyChange_discardCommitted: The change already went through on the server, so WitnessWork is finishing it.
accountKeyChange_discardOffline: Connect to the internet to discard the new key.
accountKeyChange_finishingSection: Your new key is in use. A few things are still finishing.
accountKeyChange_elsewhereBody: Your account key was changed on another device on %{date}. Your records are still on this device.
accountKeyChange_elsewhereBodyNoDate: Your account key was changed on another device. Your records are still on this device.
accountKeyChange_elsewhereHow: To sign back in, scan a QR code from a signed-in device, or use the new recovery key.
accountKeyChange_afterSignOutBody: If the device was lost or someone else might have your recovery key, change your account key so the old one stops working.
accountSecurity_sectionInfo: See which devices use your account and what's happened to it. WitnessWork keeps this history for 400 days, without locations or anything you share. Device names are encrypted so only your devices can read them.
accountActivity_suspendedDetail: Buddies and Scribe AI were turned off for this account.
accountActivity_keyChangedDetail: Your other devices were signed out and sign back in with the new key.

accountActivity_signedInRecovery: Signed in on %{device} with a recovery key
accountActivity_replacedDetail: Your account stays signed in on up to 10 devices.
accountActivity_replacedWebDetail: Your account stays signed in on up to 3 browsers.
accountActivity_reused: Signed out %{device} to protect your account
accountActivity_reusedDetail: Its sign-in was used again after it had been replaced, which can mean someone copied it. If you see a device you don't recognize, sign it out.
accountActivity_handoff: Account sent to a new phone from %{device}
accountActivity_handoffUnknown: Account sent to a new phone
accountActivity_offline: Connect to the internet to see your account activity.
accountDevices_info: Signing out ends a device's connection to your account. If WitnessWork on that device still has your account, it signs back in the next time it's used, and Account Activity shows it. A browser you sign out clears its data the next time it connects. If someone else might have your account, change your account key.
accountDevices_footer: Tap another device to sign it out.
accountDevices_signOutBody: It stops using your account. If WitnessWork on it still has your account, it signs back in the next time it's used.
accountDevices_signOutWebBody: It stops using your account, and that browser clears your data the next time it connects. Anything it hasn't synced is lost.
accountDevices_signOutFailedBody: Check your connection and try again.
accountDevices_offline: Connect to the internet to see your devices.
passkeys_info: A passkey is another way into your same account, kept by your phone, computer, or password manager. One that can unlock your account brings your account key to a new device on its own. A Sign-in only passkey signs you in, and then your phone or recovery key unlocks the account. You can have up to %{max}.
passkeys_empty: A passkey lets you sign in on a computer or a new phone with your face, fingerprint, or screen lock.
passkeys_footer: In your password manager, they're named %{name}.
passkeys_offline: Connect to the internet to see your passkeys.
passkeys_removeBody: It stops signing you in to WitnessWork. Your password manager still keeps it, so delete it there too.
passkeys_removeLastUnlockingBody:
It stops signing you in to WitnessWork. Your password manager still keeps it, so delete it there too.

It's your only passkey that can unlock your account. To sign in on a computer after this, you'll need your recovery key or another device.

passkeys_addedCanUnlockMessage: It can sign you in and unlock your account.

passkeys_failedOffline: Check your connection and try again.

passkeys_failedUpdate: Update WitnessWork to change your passkeys.
passkeys_failedUnverified: This phone couldn't be verified, so it can't change your passkeys.
passkeys_failedRateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a moment, then try again.
passkeys_failedConflict: That passkey belongs to another account.
handoff_sectionInfo: Your new phone scans a code on this one, and you check that both show the same six-digit number. It works between iPhone and Android, and both phones need the internet. Your account travels end-to-end encrypted, so the server can't read it.
handoff_sectionFooter: Move your account and buddies to another phone, or sign in here from one.
handoff_scanInstruction: On your other phone, open WitnessWork and choose Sign In with QR Code.
handoff_qrLabel: Sign-in code for your other phone
handoff_matchCode: Make sure your other phone shows this code.
handoff_allowFailed: Your account wasn't sent. Check your connection, then tap YES again.
handoff_unlockFailed: Your phone couldn't confirm it's you, so your account wasn't sent.

handoff_oldDoneBodyNoBuddies: Your account is on it now. This phone stays signed in.
handoff_problemOffline: Connect to the internet to set up another device.
handoff_problemUnavailable: Accounts aren't available right now. Try again later.

handoff_newDoneBodyNoBuddies: Your account is on this phone.

handoff_failNoAccount: Your account couldn't be found. Check your connection and try again.
handoff_failRateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
handoff_failServer: Something went wrong. Make a new code to try again.

handoff_failUnverifiedOldAndroid: WitnessWork can't verify this device, so it can't set up another one. Your account needs WitnessWork from Google Play on a device that passes Google Play's integrity check.

handoff_failUpdate: Update WitnessWork on this phone, then try again.
backup_sectionInfo: WitnessWork keeps an end-to-end encrypted copy of your service records, contacts, notes, plans, and settings. Only your devices can read it, not WitnessWork. It's free. Photos aren't included. On a new phone, you can restore it after Set Up Another Device or with your recovery key.
backup_errorOffline: Your backup continues when you're back online.
backup_errorUnavailable: Backups aren't available right now. WitnessWork tries again later.
backup_errorTooLarge: Your data is over 20 MB, which is too large to back up. Save a backup file in Settings → Backup & Restore instead.
backup_errorLimit: Your account already backs up 8 devices. Delete another device's backup below to back up this phone.
backup_errorWaiting: WitnessWork tries again in a minute.
backup_errorServer: Something went wrong. WitnessWork tries again soon.
backup_errorVerifyLater: WitnessWork couldn't verify this device just now. It tries again soon.
backup_footerOn: Backs up when your data changes, and at least once a day.
backup_footerOff: Keep an encrypted copy you can restore on a new phone. It's free, and only your devices can read it.
backup_turnOnOffline: Connect to the internet, then try again.
backup_turnOffBody: This phone stops backing up. Delete its backup from WitnessWork too? Your other devices' backups stay.
backup_turnOffDeleteFailed: Backup is off, but this phone's backup couldn't be deleted. Delete it in Settings → Account when you're online.
backup_deleteFailedBody: Check your connection, then try again.
backup_devicesFooter: Each device keeps its own backup. Restoring combines them.
backup_deleteSlotMineBody: This phone's backup is deleted from WitnessWork, and backup turns off on this phone. This can't be undone.
backup_deleteSlotOtherBody: That device's backup is deleted from WitnessWork. If backup is still on there, it backs up again. This can't be undone.
backup_deleteAllBody: Every device's backup is deleted from WitnessWork, and backup turns off on this phone. Other devices with backup on back up again. This can't be undone.

backup_restoredSkippedUnreadable: A backup that couldn't be read was left out.
backup_restoredTurnOn: Turn on backup for this phone too?

backup_restoreFailedUnreadable: Your backup couldn't be read. Nothing on this phone changed.
backup_restoreFailedServer: Something went wrong, and nothing on this phone changed. Try again from Settings → Account.

handoff_newDoneSynced: Cloud Sync is bringing your records, contacts, and notes to this phone. They appear in a moment.
handoff_newDoneSyncedCombine: This phone already has records. Open Settings → Device Sync to choose how to combine them with your account's records on Cloud Sync.
syncSettings_description: Sync keeps your service records, contacts, visits, plans, and preferences the same on your devices. Choose Cloud Sync to sync iPhone and Android together, end-to-end encrypted, or iCloud to sync your iPhone and iPad through your Apple Account.
syncSettings_descriptionAndroid: Sync keeps your service records, contacts, visits, plans, and preferences the same on your devices. Choose Cloud Sync to sync Android and iPhone together, end-to-end encrypted, or Google Drive to sync your Android devices through your Google Account.
cloudSyncOffer_body: Cloud Sync is always end-to-end encrypted, so only your devices can read your data, and it works across iPhone and Android. WitnessWork doesn't encrypt iCloud sync end to end. Your data on this device is kept and combined with your other devices on Cloud Sync.
cloudSyncOffer_bodyAndroid: Cloud Sync is always end-to-end encrypted, so only your devices can read your data, and it works across Android and iPhone. WitnessWork doesn't encrypt Google Drive sync end to end. Your data on this device is kept and combined with your other devices on Cloud Sync.
cloudSyncRequest_switchedMessage: WitnessWork on the web can use your data now.
webCloudSync_turnOnTitle: Turn on Cloud Sync to use WitnessWork here
webCloudSync_turnOnBody: Your phone keeps all its data and switches the next time you open WitnessWork on it.
webCloudSync_waitingTitle: Open WitnessWork on your phone to finish
webCloudSync_waitingBody: This page continues once your phone is on Cloud Sync.
webCloudSync_updatePhoneBody: Then open it to finish turning on Cloud Sync.
webCloudSync_turnOnFailed: Couldn't turn on Cloud Sync. Check your connection and try again.
webCloudSync_turnOnUnavailable: Cloud Sync isn't available for this account right now. Try again later.
syncOption_info: Each device syncs one way at a time, and only with devices that sync the same way. Cloud Sync stores an end-to-end encrypted copy of each device's data on WitnessWork's server: only your devices have the key, and it works on iPhone and Android. iCloud stores a copy in your iCloud Drive; Apple encrypts it, but WitnessWork doesn't encrypt it end to end, and it works only on Apple devices.
syncOption_infoAndroid: Each device syncs one way at a time, and only with devices that sync the same way. Cloud Sync stores an end-to-end encrypted copy of each device's data on WitnessWork's server: only your devices have the key, and it works on Android and iPhone. Google Drive stores a copy in a hidden folder of your Google Drive; Google protects it, but WitnessWork doesn't encrypt it end to end, and it works only on Android.
syncOption_platformSublabel: Your iCloud · iPhone and iPad only
syncOption_cloudFooter: This device syncs with your devices that use Cloud Sync, on iPhone and Android. Devices that sync with iCloud or Google Drive sync separately.
syncOption_platformFooter: This device syncs only with your devices that use iCloud. Cloud Sync is end-to-end encrypted and also works with Android.
syncOption_platformFooterAndroid: This device syncs only with your devices that use Google Drive. Cloud Sync is end-to-end encrypted and also works with iPhone.
syncOption_platformFooterMixed: This device syncs only with your devices that use iCloud. Your other devices signed in to your account may use Cloud Sync, and their changes won't appear here until this device uses Cloud Sync too.
syncOption_platformFooterMixedAndroid: This device syncs only with your devices that use Google Drive. Your other devices signed in to your account may use Cloud Sync, and their changes won't appear here until this device uses Cloud Sync too.
syncOption_security: Cloud Sync is always end-to-end encrypted, so only your devices can read your data. WitnessWork doesn't encrypt iCloud sync end to end.
syncOption_securityAndroid: Cloud Sync is always end-to-end encrypted, so only your devices can read your data. WitnessWork doesn't encrypt Google Drive sync end to end.
cloudSyncTrayOffer_freeDescription: Keep your data in step across iPhone, Android and the web, end-to-end encrypted.
cloudSyncTrayOffer_thanksDescription: Your support built Cloud Sync and WitnessWork on the web.
syncOption_switchedCloud: This device now uses Cloud Sync
syncOption_switchedPlatformAndroid: This device now uses Google Drive
syncOption_turnedOff: Sync is off on this device
syncOption_accountChanged: The account this sync uses changed. Your data is still on this device. Try again to combine it with that account's devices.
syncOption_toCloud_description: Your data on this device is kept and combined with your devices on Cloud Sync. Devices still on iCloud keep syncing with each other, but not with this one. Your iCloud copy from this device stays in iCloud.
syncOption_toCloud_descriptionAndroid: Your data on this device is kept and combined with your devices on Cloud Sync. Devices still on Google Drive keep syncing with each other, but not with this one. Your Google Drive copy from this device stays in Google Drive.
syncOption_toPlatform_description: Your data on this device is kept and combined with your devices on iCloud. This device's copy is removed from WitnessWork's server. Devices on Cloud Sync keep what they've already synced from it, but stop seeing its changes. WitnessWork doesn't encrypt iCloud sync end to end.
syncOption_toPlatform_descriptionAndroid: Your data on this device is kept and combined with your devices on Google Drive. This device's copy is removed from WitnessWork's server. Devices on Cloud Sync keep what they've already synced from it, but stop seeing its changes. WitnessWork doesn't encrypt Google Drive sync end to end.
cloudSyncNotEntitled: Cloud Sync isn’t available for your account yet. Your data is still on this device, and you can choose another way to sync in the meantime.
cloudSyncDisabled: Cloud Sync is turned off for now. Your data is still on this device. Try again later.
cloudSyncNoSession: This device couldn't connect to your WitnessWork account. Check your internet connection and try again. If it keeps happening, open Settings → Account.
cloudSyncPhotoStorage_info: Contact, profile, and note photos sync with Cloud Sync, end-to-end encrypted. Deleting a photo frees its space right away.
cloudSyncPhotoStorage_fullInfo: New photos stay on the device that added them until there's room. Photos already synced aren't affected.
cloudSyncTurnOff_description: This device stops syncing, and its copy is removed from WitnessWork's server. Your data stays on this device, and your other devices keep what they've already synced from it.
iCloudSync_summaryCloud: Sync across iPhone and Android, end-to-end encrypted.
iCloudSync_descriptionCloud: Syncs contacts, visits, Service Reports, and preferences across your iPhone and Android devices through WitnessWork's server, end-to-end encrypted.

iCloudPrivacyNoteCloud: Each device's data is encrypted on the device with a key only your devices have, then stored on WitnessWork's server. WitnessWork can't read it.
iCloudFirstEnableDescriptionCloud: Both this device and Cloud Sync already have data. Choose how to start syncing.

iCloudChoiceUseRemoteDescCloud: Replace this device's data with what's in Cloud Sync. Use this if your real data lives on another phone or tablet.

iCloudStatusRateLimitedCloud: Cloud Sync is busy — retrying soon
iCloudStatusStorageFullCloud: Too much data for Cloud Sync

scribe_zdrIntro: When you use Scribe AI, what you say or type, and the records it needs to answer, go to an AI model to work out your update. Here’s what happens to them.
scribe_zdrNothingStoredBody: Once Scribe AI answers, what you sent is gone. WitnessWork’s server never stores or logs it: no messages, names, notes or photos. It only counts how much you’ve used.
scribe_zdrNoTrainingBody: Scribe AI only uses AI providers that agree, by contract, to keep none of your data and never train on it.
scribe_zdrOnDeviceBody: Your conversations and Scribe AI’s memory are saved only on this device. When you speak, your voice is turned into text on this device, and the recording isn’t saved.
scribe_zdrInControlBody: Scribe AI only suggests changes. Nothing is added until you tap Add, and you can turn Scribe AI off in Settings anytime.
scribe_zdrPolicyLink: Read OpenRouter’s zero data retention policy
scribe_termsPrivateBody: Scribe AI only uses what you send to work out your update. It isn’t stored, and it’s never used to train AI.
scribe_termsMistakesBody: AI can make mistakes. Review each change before you add it.
scribe_termsBody: By tapping Agree, you accept WitnessWork’s Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
scribe_memoryInfoBody: When you correct Scribe AI, use your own words for something, or ask it to remember, it saves a short note here and reads these notes at the start of every conversation. You can edit them or add your own; changes apply from your next conversation. They stay on this device.
scribe_memoryPlaceholder: Nothing yet. Correct Scribe AI or say “Remember…” and it saves a note here.
scribe_memoryOffNote: Scribe AI doesn’t read or save these notes while memory is off.
scribe_memoryClearConfirm: Clear every note? Scribe AI forgets them in new conversations.
scribe_usageInfoBody: Usage depends on how much Scribe AI reads and writes, not on how many messages you send. Quick updates use a little; long conversations and paper pages use more. Each limit starts with your first use and resets at the time shown.
scribe_usageStale: Couldn’t check for newer usage. This is what Scribe AI last reported.
